predecessors.name: Eastern Wei
predecessors.text: the Eastern Wei realm that Gao Yang took from Emperor Xiaojing in 550

successors.name: Northern Zhou
successors.text: all of Northern Qi's territory north of the Huai, taken in 577

ledger.x: 550: Gao Yang founds the Northern Qi at Yecheng.
573: the Chen take the land between the Yangtze and the Huai.

wars.name: Qi-Liang and Chen border wars
wars.outcome: Border battles in 552-554 and a stalemate then defeat of Qi forces at Jiankang in the summer of 556; no border change is recorded on the page.

wars.name: Zhou-Qi wars
wars.outcome: Zhou victory: attacks with the Tujue in 563 and on Luoyang in 564 and 575 failed; Pingyang fell in winter 576, Jinyang around the new year and Ye in spring 577.

wars.name: Chen northern expedition of 573
wars.outcome: Chen victory: Wu Mingche took the land between the Yangtze and the Huai; Shouyang was captured and the Qi commander Wang Lin killed.

certainty.note: No treaty fixes any frontier; the Great Wall works of 552, 555, 557 and 563 mark the northern edge, but the steppe frontier with the Tujue and the Yangtze-Huai frontier with the Chen are approximate.
